about: Optional: sound effects the game synthesises today that are worth replacing with recorded or ElevenLabs Sound Effects audio. The radio group carries every radio line; the rest is ambience. Every entry is a drop-in: same name, same role. See HANDOFF.md section 5 for how a file replaces a synthesised sound.

sounds.name: radioIn
sounds.used_by: src/engine/voice.js: start of every radio line (volume 0.6), skipped when the clip has radioBaked: true
sounds.prompt: Police two-way radio key-up: a short squelch burst with a tiny chirp as the channel opens, band-limited, dry, mono, 0.3 seconds
sounds.notes: Must start on the transient: no silence at the head.

sounds.name: radioOut
sounds.used_by: src/engine/voice.js: end of every radio line (volume 0.5). ALSO src/main.js glitch(): the camera signal-loss glitch plays it pitched down (rate 0.5 to 0.9)
sounds.prompt: Police radio squelch tail when the transmit key is released: a short hiss burst cut off abruptly, band-limited, dry, mono, 0.3 seconds
sounds.notes: Also doubles as the camera glitch sound, so keep it noisy rather than tonal.

sounds.name: radioStatic
sounds.used_by: src/engine/voice.js: static bed under every radio line (volume 0.12). Today it is faked with the breath0 buffer played at rate 3.5, which is why the new name is needed: see HANDOFF.md section 5
sounds.prompt: Low steady police radio static: soft hiss with faint crackle and a little digital warble, no voices, no tones, seamless loop, 4 seconds

sounds.name: tvStatic
sounds.used_by: src/game/story.js:172, the snowy TV in apartment 1C (positional emitter, volume 0.2). Today it is breath0 again
sounds.prompt: Old CRT television tuned to a dead channel: white-noise snow with a faint 15 kHz whine, seamless loop, 4 seconds

sounds.name: carIdle
sounds.used_by: src/game/story.js:320, the patrol car engine during the intro drive (ambience bus, volume 0.25). Today it is breath1 at rate 0.35
sounds.prompt: Interior of a police sedan at idle and low speed: low V8 engine rumble, heater fan, no music, no voices, seamless loop, 4 seconds

sounds.name: beep
sounds.used_by: src/game/story.js:316, body camera switching to record after its 30 s silent pre-event buffer
sounds.prompt: Body-worn camera starts recording: two short electronic beeps at about 1 kHz, 0.28 seconds apart, dry, mono

sounds.name: siren
sounds.used_by: src/game/story.js:319 (on the patrol car roof, ambience bus, volume 0.25) and :691 (on the SWAT van in the ending, 3-D positioned, volume 1.2)
sounds.prompt: American police car siren, classic wail cycle, heard from close by outdoors, no engine, no voices, seamless loop, 8 seconds
sounds.notes: Seamless loop. The synthesised one fades in and out inside its 9 s buffer, so it pulses when looped; a real loop fixes that.

sounds.name: fireAlarm
sounds.used_by: src/game/story.js:171, fire alarm horn in the lobby (positional emitter, volume 0.55)
sounds.prompt: Building fire alarm horn, temporal-3 pattern (three half-second blasts, then a pause), indoor, seamless loop, 4 seconds

sounds.name: rain
sounds.used_by: src/engine/audio.js startAmbience(): the rain bed everywhere; the engine low-passes it indoors
sounds.prompt: Steady heavy night rain on pavement and puddles in a city courtyard, no thunder, no traffic, stereo, seamless loop, 6 seconds
